Definition: Achi, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ahi is named twice: a chief among the Gadites, and a son of Shamer among the sons of Asher — two men, one short name, both appearing only in genealogies. Beyond these verses the Bible tells no more of either man.
TheologicalSignificance: There is nothing more to say about either man, and I will not stretch a verse into a sermon. The genealogies keep their names because the tribes kept their families.
